integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.lead: Keys for sending email and signing in with Google. Paste a key here — no need to log in to the server. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
steps_email: Sign up at resend.com (free: 3,000 emails a month).
Domains → Add Domain → add {domain}. Add the DNS records it shows (MX, TXT) in your domain panel and press “Verify”.
API Keys → Create API Key (Sending access) → paste the key below.
steps_google: APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen: External, app name and your email, “Publish app”.
Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application.
Paste the Client ID and Client secret below.
integrations.test_lead: A test message is sent to your email.
integrations.notice_yuborildi: Test email sent — check your inbox (and Spam).
integrations.notice_ulanmagan: Email is not connected yet: enter the Resend key first.
integrations.notice_xato: Not sent: check the key and that the domain is verified (Resend → Domains → Verified).
steps_ai: Billing → add a card and top up the balance (e.g. $10). Leave “Auto reload” off — when the balance runs out, the AI simply returns to test mode.
Settings → Limits: set a monthly spend limit (e.g. $20).
API Keys → Create Key → paste the key below.
Model: Settings → Xorazmiy AI → ai.model (economical: claude-sonnet-5-5).
